author: Old_tangyuan
description: Layered context compression with KV-cache-friendly design. Pre-compresses conversation history in a background cache and injects a single summary block when the context window reaches the threshold, keeping recent rounds as-is.

zh.description: 分层上下文压缩插件，KV-cache 友好设计。在后台缓存中预压缩对话历史，达到阈值时注入单条摘要，保持最近轮次原文不动。
